_about: Penerone (111159, catbaby_psychicer): a small, very polite catfolk girl trying to act grown-up. Translated from the game's Japanese. Global names/terms: Penerone, Nao Nagihara (calls Alk "big brother"), Shota (Shou), Alk, Light, Nimbus, catfolk/dogfolk, Fang Canyon. Own: Fang Welfare Corps (牙の福祉団), Kittenkinesis (skill, as in units.json).
profile: An honest, polite catfolk girl. She tries to act grown-up despite her young age. Behind her adorable looks, she apparently hides a tremendous power.
titleCondition: Level Penerone to 100 and obtain her Amity Scroll

speech.home/otetsudai: Is there anything I can help with? Heavy lifting or anything at all, leave it to me♪ I'll do it with a heave and a hup!
speech.home/watakushi_hayaku: I want to become a lovely grown-up soon! Cooking, reading and writing, music, sewing... I have so much to study!
speech.home/fuaa_unya: Fwaaah~... Unya... nyann-- Ah. N-no, I was certainly not yawning...! Grown-ups can stay awake without a nap...!
speech.home/fufun_moo: Hmhm, balls won't distract me anymore. I've grown up too-- Nya!? Wh-why are you throwing the ball, Mr. Nimbus... Ugh... Unya... Unyaaaaaaaa~♪
speech.home/ara_hyottoshite: Oh my. Could it be that you're tired? Sometimes it's important to spoil yourself, you know. ...So, won't you take a nap together with me?
speech.home/alksan_naosan: Mr. Alk. Ms. Nao is a wonderful person. She's kind, cute, smart, and amazing! So... please don't let her feel lonely. I'm counting on you...!!
speech.ally/join: My name is Penerone. I'm studying to become a lovely grown-up. I hope you'll remember me, all right?
speech.ally/evolution: Wow...! Look! I've grown up again. The day I become a lovely grown-up is near! Please keep relying on me, all right?

1.title: To Be a Lovely Grown-Up
1.summary: Stuck when their carriage falls into a ditch, Alk and the others are rescued by the psychic powers of Penerone, a catfolk girl from a nearby village. After showing them to her home, Penerone convinces her parents to let her go to Starview Village, so she can master her powers and become a lovely grown-up.

lines.5: It's no use. It's completely stuck in the ditch...
lines.8: If only Nimbus were here... We're so close to the village, too--
lines.13: Oh my, oh my. Are you in trouble?
lines.18: If you like, would you leave it to me-- Penerone?
lines.23: Ah, wait...! It might cave in, so you'd better not come any closer--
lines.27: Hehe, there's no need to worry. I'll help you with my power♪
lines.35: How's that? With my power, something like this is no trouble at all.
lines.40: Thank you! You saved us...! That's an amazing power...
lines.44: Hehehe, not at all! I'm someone who aims to be a lovely grown-up. I only did what was natural--
lines.67: Th-that's not it...! I'm certainly not interested in something so childish!
lines.70: Huh? N-no, it's not that it's childish, it's just so cat-like that it surprised me--
lines.75: L-look! I can do this too! I'm not a little kiiid!
lines.84: O-okay! We get it! Just put everything down for now!
lines.90: Um... Thanks again, Penerone. Thanks to you, we finished our job safely.
lines.94: I-I'm glad I could be of help. You must be tired from your long trip, so please rest well...!
lines.99: ...That said, nobody seems to be here. Where are your parents...?
lines.102: We live together. But Father and Mother are very busy with their social welfare work.
lines.106: Food aid, infrastructure repair, conflict mediation... They do so much important work!
lines.111: ...I see. You really respect your parents, huh.
lines.114: But isn't it lonely, waiting for them all by yourself...?
lines.119: No, not at all! A lovely grown-up doesn't lean on anyone and can do anything by herself--
lines.130: Sorry for barging in... We came to this village for work, and she helped us out on the way.
lines.132: Oh my... I see. Was it with that strange power of hers--?
lines.135: Are you both done with work? Aren't you going out again today?
lines.137: Yes, today we're fine. What do you want to play? Last time you said you wanted to read a picture book, didn't you?
lines.140: N-no...! Don't worry about me, please rest! You have work tomorrow too, don't you?
lines.143: That's right. First, I have to make tea for you both!
lines.146: A-are you all right, Pene? Didn't you use your power to help these people too...?
lines.149: Yes! I lifted the carriage up, hnngh! And they thanked me!
lines.153: Pardon me, but since when has she had that power...?
lines.156: About six months ago, I think... All of a sudden, she was able to make things and herself float.
lines.157: We don't have any power like that. We're worried it might have a bad effect on her or put a strain on her...
lines.160: I-I'm all right! See, I'm full of energy!
lines.164: ...Um. Maybe we can help, just a little.
lines.169: There are people with powers like hers at our base. They might be able to teach her how to get along with her ability.
lines.177: The thing is, our base is pretty far away. It's just something to consider if you feel like it...
lines.182: ...Thank you. It's very interesting, but neither my husband nor I can take time off work for a while...
lines.183: Right... Sending our daughter alone would be too worrying, after all--
lines.190: I'm not a little kid anymore. To become a lovely grown-up... I can even stand on my own!
lines.193: E-even if it means being apart from Father and Mother, I, I--!
lines.197: ...Sorry. I made you anxious. But you won't be separated from your parents, I promise.
lines.206: Yeah. Your home stays here. If you feel like it, we'd be happy if you came to visit our place. ...How about that?
lines.210: Father, Mother. I still want to go.
lines.214: I'll learn to master my power. So I can become a lovely grown-up...!
lines.219: How lovely...! I never knew a world like this existed...!
lines.222: Thank you so much! I will repay you someday, without fail!
lines.225: Don't worry about it. Here, you can use your power as much as you like--
lines.235: Th-that's not it! This is, um... I-I can't stoooop...!
lines.239: Uuu...! Someday, I promise... I promise I'll become a lovely grown-uuup!

2.title: Everything I Want to Do
2.summary: Penerone is excited to finally spend time with her parents tomorrow, but sudden work comes up for them and she is crushed. Though she holds back her wish to be pampered, on Nao's advice she finishes their work ahead of time, so she can spend the day with her parents to her heart's content.

lines.6: Alright, cleaning done~! Thanks, Penerone! You were a huge help!
lines.10: Hehe, leave it to me. Thanks to everyone, I've mastered controlling my power♪
lines.14: You seem to be in a great mood. Something good happen?
lines.19: Actually... tomorrow, Father and Mother have the day off work for the first time in a long while...!
lines.23: Ahh, I see...! No wonder you're so happy.
lines.28: Yes...! We'll eat together, and talk, and read picture books-- There's so much I want to do!
lines.32: Good work on the cleaning. ...Perfect timing, in more ways than one.

lines.40: B-but, I didn't help because I wanted a reward, um...!
lines.43: Well, actually, it's a new recipe. I want to hear what you think. Your parents too, if you like.
lines.51: Big brother. Don't tell me there's no cake for Nao?
lines.55: Yes, yes, I made you some too. ...Penerone, want to eat another one now, separate from the souvenir?
lines.61: Huh, Penerone? Didn't you go home...?
lines.65: ...Father and Mother got some sudden work. So, tomorrow too.
lines.69: I-I'm all right! I'm used to it! I just came to return the cake--
lines.73: Penerone. Let's eat that cake right now!
lines.76: Huh? B-but, we already had some at lunch...?
lines.80: Actually, I wanted to eat more~. And also, talking and reading picture books and stuff--
lines.84: Let's do all of it. Everything you want to do, Penerone!
lines.91: Haah... That picture book was so much fun too...! It made me all teary...!
lines.94: Right? Nao loves it too~. People read it to me a lot when I was little.
lines.97: Okay. What should we do next, Pene?
lines.101: M-Ms. Nao. You've already played with me so much...! I can't impose on you any more than--
lines.105: Aww, are you sure~? Right now, Nao can do anything~?
lines.113: Th-then... um... Th-this might be a bother, but...
lines.122: Here you go! Right this way!
lines.141: S-sorry...! Th-that just now was, um...!
lines.147: ...I knew it. You wanted your mom and dad to come home, didn't you?
lines.151: ...Will you keep it a secret from everyone...?
lines.154: Of course. A secret just between Nao and Pene!
lines.160: I want them to brush me, and pet me. ...And hug me tight. ...I want to be with them more...
lines.164: B-but. It's also not a lie that I don't want to get in the way of their work...!
lines.168: ...I see. Honestly, sometimes Nao thinks a brother who keeps her waiting deserves some trouble--
lines.170: But you don't want to cause them trouble, do you, Pene?
lines.174: Th-that's right. I just, I just...!
lines.177: ...I want to become a lovely grown-up. Like my kind mother and father...
lines.184: If you help your parents with their work, get more time together, and get pampered too, wouldn't that be a perfect score...?
lines.189: A p-perfect score. A gold star, totally correct...!
lines.193: Let's do it all, Pene. Let's do something so lovely and grown-up it leaves everyone behind!
lines.202: ...We did something awful to Pene. I almost wish she'd just get angry...
lines.203: You know how kind she is, don't you? This time, we'll finish work early, and--
lines.206: Alright. That's the last of it, right? Count's all good!
lines.211: Yes. Perfectly complete! Thank you, everyone!
lines.214: P-Pene...!? What are you doing here? And what are you...
lines.217: Father, Mother! I finished today's work for you both!
lines.220: Everyone helped me. So now there's nothing at all left for you to do!
lines.224: --So. Today, all day! Please play with me...!
lines.230: I'm sorry for always relying on you... I've wanted to do this for so, so long.
lines.232: Let's play lots. Tell me everything you want to do, okay?
lines.234: What should we do first? Ball games, card games--
lines.239: Hehe. I always wanted to fly together with you both!
lines.243: Today, I'll do everything I want to do!
lines.246: Father, Mother. I love you sooo much...!

3.title: My First Job
3.summary: Asked by her parents to deliver a letter to a dogfolk town, Penerone sets off from home full of enthusiasm. Watched over by Nao and the others as they secretly follow her, she helps someone in need and completes the job, taking one more step toward becoming a lovely grown-up who can both work and be pampered perfectly.

lines.5: Letter, check. Map, check. Lunch, check. Snacks, check. ...My preparations are perfect!
lines.8: Hey, are you really gonna be okay? Maybe we should come with you after all...
lines.12: No, I'll go by myself. It's a "job" Father and Mother asked me to do!
lines.16: Delivering a letter to the dogfolk town... It's simple, but it's an important job. I'll do my best!
lines.19: But the village is pretty far, right? Going all alone is kinda...
lines.23: Thank you for worrying. But it's close enough that I can be back before night.
lines.27: ...Gotcha. Well, if anything happens, rely on the people around you, okay? We'll be right behind--
lines.31: Good luck, Pene! We'll be waiting for you to come back!
lines.44: S-sorry, okay? It's a secret, right? That her parents secretly asked us to watch over her.
lines.49: Right! With stuff like this, it's important that she never notices, all the way to the end!
lines.52: Let's go, Sho! Watch-over staff squad, move out!
lines.63: Oh, my...? Which way is it...?
lines.67: Ahh, not that way...! She'll totally get lost! I should tell her after all--!
lines.71: Sho, stay. It's fine. It's fine.
lines.76: This is where I turn "right". The hand I hold my fork with is "left"... So--?
lines.80: It's this way! That was close...!
lines.84: Ooh. She's doing great...! Maybe we really didn't need to worry.
lines.90: Yep yep! At this rate she'll be back by evening--
lines.97: Wh-what's wrong? All alone in a place like this...
lines.100: Ngh... Uuu... Where am I...? Where's Mommy...?
lines.103: ...It's all right. I'll look for her with you!
lines.105: So please don't cry anymore? ...Here, have this.
lines.111: I'm fine. I'm not hungry right now.
lines.113: First, let's cheer you up and find your mommy together, okay?
lines.117: Oh, thank goodness...! I'm sorry you were lonely...!
lines.124: I-I'm glad you found each other safely. Well, I'll be going...
lines.127: Wait, young lady...! Would you like to stay at our house tonight?
lines.129: It'll be dark soon. It's dangerous for a child alone, and we'd like to thank you with dinner...
lines.132: Thank you for your kindness. But I'm all right! I'm almost at my destination.
lines.135: ...Are you sure...? If anything happens, come by anytime. Our house is right nearby.

lines.150: ...H-hey. Isn't that enough already? She tried hard enough, right...?
lines.163: This is my precious first job. And besides--
lines.167: Ms. Nao and the others are waiting for me...!
lines.171: ...Maybe we really didn't need to worry, huh?
lines.176: Mm. I have indeed received it, thank you. Could you give my regards to your parents?
lines.179: Yes, of course. I shall pass it on!
lines.188: Heh heh~. Nao believed in her, though! I knew Pene would be fine!
lines.192: M-Ms. Nao? Mr. Shota? Why are you here...!?
lines.196: Honestly, that's mean. Do you trust me that little?
lines.200: L-like I said, we're sorry! There's a deep reason for this--
lines.204: Hehe, I'm only joking. More importantly...
lines.207: My first job... The truth is, I was nervous about whether I could do it properly.
lines.216: A perfect score! A gold star, totally, totally correct!
lines.224: Thank you so much! I'm so glad...!
lines.228: Now, let's go home! The job isn't over until you get home safely!
lines.231: Is that something to say while you're being carried?
lines.235: It's fine! Doing work, being kind, and being pampered, all perfectly--
lines.239: I'll become that kind of lovely grown-up!

5000636/1.19:
The social welfare organization Penerone's parents work for.
Founded after the peace, its work ranges widely, from rebuilding to food aid to infrastructure repair.

Thanks to the efforts of its workers, the recovery is progressing, but lately the long working hours of the workers themselves have become an issue, and they are working toward a solution.
